title: Grilling with Fire: Flare-Ups, Fat Control, and Flambé Flavor

locations.name: Boston area
locations.basis: Explicit mention of a bartender in the Boston area; not necessarily the filming location

summary: This Techniquely episode from America's Test Kitchen explores how fire shapes flavor across grilling, indoor flame techniques, and even cocktails. It covers prepping chicken thighs with a gochujang-based paste, cooking on a two-zone grill to control flare-ups, and finishing on the hot side for crisp skin and smoky notes. The segment then transitions to indoors, explaining wok hei-style flavor and the flambé technique, illustrated with a Calvados-enhanced pork chop dish, safety steps, and how flame-driven Maillard browning contributes depth to sauces. The video concludes with practical cocktail flame tips and an orange-garnish demonstration, emphasizing subtlety and safety when using fire to tweak flavor.
